										bonus2 bSubEle,Ele_Earth,-25;
									} else if (.@id == 4984) {	// DEF SupplementReactor
										bonus bDef,100;
									}
								} else {
									if (.@id == 4985) {	// PD Supplement Reactor
										bonus bFlee2,3;
									} else if (.@id == 4986) {	// Attack Supplement Reactor
										bonus bBaseAtk,20;
									} else if (.@id == 4987) {	// Magic Supplement Reactor
										bonus bMatk,20;
									}
								}
							} else {
								if (.@id <= 4990) {
									if (.@id == 4988) {	// HP Supplement Reactor
										bonus bMaxHPrate,5;
									} else if (.@id == 4989) {	// SP Supplement Reactor
										bonus bMaxSPrate,3;
									} else if (.@id == 4990) {	// Frozen Supplement Reactor
										bonus2 bResEff,Eff_Freeze,10000;
									}
								} else {
									if (.@id == 4991) {	// ASPD Supplement Reactor
										bonus bAspd,1;
									} else if (.@id == 4992) {	// HP Absorb 1
										bonus2 bHPDrainRate,10,1;
									} else if (.@id == 4993) {	// SP Absorb 1
										bonus2 bSPDrainRate,10,1;
									}
								}
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return;
}
